mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling the gas envelope was most worthwhile: it explained why losing energy allows a core to gather more gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final cooling step felt less engaging because it was the only offered combination and largely completed an already clear sequence.

surprise.text: I had not expected envelope cooling to be necessary for further gas accumulation.

arbitrary.text: Using open space to cool the final envelope was plausible, but its specific role in producing the finished world was less clear than in the gas-giant path.

continue.text: Yes. The contrast between the two worlds made formation timing understandable, and I would be curious to see how the story connects these worlds to later events.
